chapter.heading: 2 Thessalonians 3
Pray for Us
chapter.v: the word of the Lord may speed ahead and be honored, as happened among you,
we have confidence in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things that we command.
direct your hearts to the love of God and to the steadfastness of Christ.
who is walking in idleness and not in accord with the tradition that you received from us.
we were not idle when we were with you,
with toil and labor we worked night and day, that we might not be a burden to any of you.
If anyone is not willing to work, let him not eat.
Now such persons we command and encourage in the Lord Jesus Christ to do their work quietly and to earn their own living.
do not grow weary in doing good.
have nothing to do with him, that he may be ashamed.
The Lord be with you all.
this greeting with my own hand. This is the sign of genuineness in every letter of mine; it is the way I write.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
